what: Stage 2 round A: the Stage 0 screen of every reference of the set, walks and moves (STAGE2_75_PLAN.md A12)
note: prescribed references that the joints follow exactly, on the round-two model; nothing adopted

rules.source: STAGE2_75_PLAN.md A12 (the round-A design's section 3.7); nothing but the gates below blocks a freeze

gates.gate: a drive's cont, peak or speed ratio above 1, the neck's and the tail's apart (the legs' six drives; on a body with the expressive head, its two as well)
a neck or tail drive's ratio above 1 (inverse dynamics, as Stage 0 reads it): a1_over
gates.turn: does not block: frozen with a1_over and read under the plan's third reading only

gates.gate: ik_ok; the single-support CoP margin (walks and non-causal moves: Stage 0's -10 mm; causal moves: +10 mm)
each planned swing's mid-swing minimum of the pads under 0.04 H
interference at home or along the frames; component overlap; tail clearance

gates.turn: thigh twist: use of the usable range at most 0.87; every other gated joint 0.05 rad

gates.gate: forward CoM acceleration low-passed at 1 Hz above 1.5 m/s^2 (decision 10)

a gate's reading is missing (no single-support CoP margin; no joint-range margins, none for a joint other than a turn's thigh twist, or no thigh-twist use; a contact split that did not solve; a clearance gate that is not true; usable ranges that are not plant.usable_ranges(body)'s or were not compared with them)
grip need at mu 0.9 and 0.54; sway against 0.12 H; passive neck and tail loads; the re-priced walk and the re-solved contact against the record

rules.joint_range_move: the joint-range gate of a move (a start, change, stop or turn) is 0.05 rad on every gated joint but a turn's thigh twist; a walk keeps 0.10 rad; it was 0.10 rad for every reference (the owner's decision of 15 Nov, DECISION_LOG.md P34, after the first builds of the three sets; changed after a result)
rules.a1_over: true when a neck or tail group's cont, peak or speed ratio exceeds 1
rules.not_read: a gate that is not read is not passed: the item in verdict.blocks_freeze begins 'not read: ' and names the reading
rules.sustained: a move's sustained (cont) ratio is its torque's RMS over time / sustained torque: each frame is weighted by its duration (half the time between its two neighbours; the first and the last frame by their one interval). The value with every frame the same weight is kept beside it (rms_frames, cont_ratio_frames). On a walk, whose frames are uniform in time, the two are the same number: a file whose frame durations differ by at most 1e-9 of their mean is given the frame-weighted value as both
rules.accel_end: the 1 Hz reading is the file's own, with no history before its first or after its last frame: a peak within 1 s of an end is marked (com_forward_lp1hz_peak_at_end) and the largest value at least 1 s from both ends is given beside it; the gate reads the peak wherever it lies
rules.cyclic_swing: a move is refused when a foot is in swing on its last frame, or when a swing on its first frame does not begin there (swing_u above 1e-6, or no swing_u): clearance.screen reads swings as cyclic runs and takes the middle half of each run, which on a cut swing is not the swing's
